summary: The code is syntactically valid and runs as a module, but it does not fully implement the required specification. Key metrics are missing, several entity attributes/behaviors and interactions are incomplete or mismatched with the task, and there is a critical logic issue where daily mask-wearing status is not reset based on daily decisions. Parameter names diverge from the spec, so many provided parameters would be ignored. Networkx is required and handled, performance is acceptable for the intended scale, and the main() call pattern meets the sandbox requirement.

issues.description: Required metrics are missing or misnamed: time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption_rate, steady_state_adoption_rate, mandate_effect_size, adoption_inequality_index, noncompliance_under_mandate are not computed. The code returns different metrics (e.g., time_to_reach_threshold, compliance_rate_under_mandate).
issues.solution: Compute and return the specified metrics: (a) time_to_50_percent_adoption (first day adoption >= 0.5), (b) peak_adoption_rate (max of time series), (c) steady_state_adoption_rate (mean over last 20% of days), (d) mandate_effect_size (difference in adoption with vs without mandate; run counterfactual or track differential), (e) adoption_inequality_index (Gini or CV across demographic groups), (f) noncompliance_under_mandate (1 - compliance rate on mandate-active days). Ensure names match the spec.

issues.description: Daily wearing state is not reset based on the new daily decision. Once is_wearing_mask becomes True, it typically remains True regardless of that day’s willingness or inventory status.
issues.location: Simulation.step(), per-agent decision update and wearing assignment
issues.solution: At each step, set is_wearing_mask = willing and (mask_inventory > 0), or apply a probabilistic wearing choice. Also, tie mask consumption to wearing days and ensure when inventory reaches 0, is_wearing_mask becomes False.

issues.description: Entity attributes and naming deviate from the specification. Person lacks several specified attributes (e.g., age_group, income_level, compliance_propensity naming, etc.) and some behaviors are missing (move_between_locations, communicate_with_peers). Location lacks mask_requirement_level (recommended/required), public_visibility, open_hours.
issues.solution: Align class attributes and behaviors with the spec: add/rename attributes (e.g., age_group, income_level, current_location_id, compliance_propensity), implement move_between_locations and communicate_with_peers, and make location.mask_requirement_level string-based (e.g., 'recommended'|'required') along with public_visibility and open_hours.

issues.description: PolicyAuthority entity is implemented as PolicyMaker with different attributes and methods. Enforcement resources, policy_type, and allocate_enforcement/campaign targeting are not modeled. Fine amount is not used to affect behavior.
issues.location: PolicyMaker class and its usage in Simulation.step()
issues.solution: Rename PolicyMaker to PolicyAuthority (or provide an adapter) and add attributes mandate_status, policy_type, enforcement_resources, messaging_budget, campaign_targeting_strategy. Use fine_amount and enforcement_probability to affect perceived cost or compliance probability in decision utility. Provide allocate_enforcement and conduct_messaging_campaign consistent with the spec.

issues.description: Retailer behavior differs. Purchase limits per person and per-day supply constraints per the spec are not enforced. Parameter names differ (Vendor vs Retailer).
issues.solution: Implement purchase_limit_per_person tracking per agent per day and ensure retailers respect restock_rate_per_day and inventory. Consider renaming Vendor to Retailer or providing a wrapper, and accept parameter purchase_limit_per_person from config.

issues.description: Observational norms in location are not implemented. local_norm_compliance is defined but never updated or used to alter wearing decisions within locations.
issues.solution: Compute and update location-level visibility (local_norm_compliance) based on current occupants and incorporate a within-location normative pressure that adjusts daily wearing decisions when agents are at that location.

issues.description: Parameter names diverge from the spec and are not mapped. For example, average_degree vs network_avg_degree; enforcement_probability vs mandate_enforcement_prob; cost_sensitivity vs adoption_cost_weight; mask_supply_per_day vs supply_restock_per_day_per_capita.
issues.solution: Add a parameter mapping layer that translates the spec’s parameter names to internal names. Prefer to accept both names or directly adopt the spec’s naming to ensure that provided configurations are honored.

issues.description: MediaChannel omitted attributes (credibility, bias) and message_frequency/effect size from the spec are not explicitly modeled; net effect is simplified.
issues.solution: Add credibility and bias attributes, and incorporate messaging_frequency and message_effect_size into the broadcast model. Targeting strategy can be implemented by selecting subsets of agents based on demographic filters.

issues.description: Move between locations and daily scheduling (open_hours) are not modeled; all agents are at a single public location.
issues.solution: Create multiple locations (home, work, public) with open_hours and implement move_between_locations behavior based on daily schedules. Enforce entry policies and observational norms per location.

issues.description: Cost sensitivity uses global budget_mean rather than individual budgets; fine_amount has no effect on utility.
issues.solution: Normalize cost by the agent’s own budget or income and include expected penalty term (enforcement_probability * fine_amount) into the cost portion of utility when mandate is active.

issues.description: If networkx is unavailable, a RuntimeError is raised, which is acceptable, but other parameter inconsistencies from user-supplied configs are silently ignored due to defaults.
issues.solution: Validate user-supplied parameters against the spec and warn or error on unknown/missing required fields. Provide clear messages when falling back to defaults.

issues.description: Unused imports: argparse, json, sys, matplotlib (HAS_MPL) is detected but never used.
issues.solution: Remove unused imports or implement optional plotting/CLI to justify them.
